description: The first end-to-end test of Blueprint and Protocol: a minutes package and a generic runner take real meeting transcripts through ten recorded stages to minutes, a decision log and a task list with line-level provenance. What worked, what the runner had to supply, and what SRS is missing.
name: research-minutes-blueprint
title: Minutes with provenance: how far a Blueprint and Protocol can lead a transcript (2026-11-27)
